Road Rules: X-Treme | Road Rules: X-Treme is the 13th season of the MTV reality television series "Road Rules", which takes a group of young people and places them on a series of quests and challenges to compete for prizes.  "X-Treme" took place in South America, in Argentina and Chile.  It was the first and only "Road Rules" season to have a dog to be credited as part of the cast.
